_note: RETIRED (2026-08-05). This config used to train the population now named 4_deck_subleague_test, back when it was still called 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet -- see SWAP_EXPERIMENT.md at the repo root for the full history (the primary/gauntlet role swap and the subsequent directory rename to match). After the rename, this file's old league_name ("4_deck_subleague_gauntlet") would resolve to the FROZEN reference population instead -- training against it would be a real mistake, not a harmless no-op -- so the operational fields are deliberately removed rather than left stale: run_league.py hard-asserts on a missing league_name for any auto-sizing invocation, so pointing at this file by accident fails loudly instead of quietly training the wrong league. Use training_configs/run_default.json for all ongoing training.
